Exposure Validation Made Easy
Beat attackers at their own game. Automate and scale offensive testing with templates and guided, agentic AI workflows to prove threat resilience in any environment.
Focus on the Exploitable
Stop drowning in vulnerabilities. Correlate proof of threat resilience with aggregated data from scanners and discovery tools to prioritize exposures that pose real risk.

Take immediate action. Improve threat resilience with custom detection rules and automated mitigation to update security controls for continuously stronger defense.
Measure and Prove Threat Resilience
Know where you stand. Validate security posture specific to frameworks like NIST 800-52, CIS Critical Security Controls and MITRE ATT&CK for clear benchmarking and visibility.
